name: Chocolat Neige
source:
Likes: Kurou's cakes 
Dislikes: Studying
Favorite cake: Mille crêpes

The daughter of the president of a large company who has come to take over Folkroll. At first, she follows her brother and tries to shut down Folkroll, but after eating the cake made by Kurou, she turns into an ally of the shop. She is a customer, but if she is rewarded with a cake, she will do anything, including working as a waitress.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/clear_0018/]DMM[/url]]
